messages:
riley_marketing: Two-day reminder: need final confirmation on changelog bullets, canonical docs URL, and canary start time so we can schedule the newsletter and socials.

devon_eng: Canary plan OK: 30m smoke -> 90m canary -> ramp. Proposed canary start 2026-04-09T04:00:00Z, endpoints /v1/generate & /v1/embeddings. Rollback if 5xx > 1.5% for 10m.

sasha_docs: Docs PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/531. If merged canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-04-09. I'll add a note about the `enable_model_pinning` flag.

maya_product: Merge docs before publish if possible. Add a blurb: "Dedicated customers: contact CS for assisted rollouts."

quentin_sales: HubSpot form: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/apr9-release. Tags: ["apr9-release","bench-webinar"]. Will auto-tag benchmark-origin leads.

riley_marketing: Draft announce: "Faster cold-starts, optional model pinning, and smarter batching. See changelog + docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-04-09. Webinar Thurs 10am PT  register." Need bench PNG for blog hero by EOD tomorrow.

devon_eng: Perf will export median-latency PNG and attach here by 2026-04-08 18:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-04-09T03:30:00Z; canary 2026-04-09T04:00:00Z -> 2026-04-09T05:30:00Z; ramp 2026-04-09T06:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds posted.

riley_marketing: Final checklist: 1) canonical docs URL (sasha), 2) canary endpoints + thresholds (devon), 3) HubSpot + tags (quentin), 4) bench PNG (devon). If all green we lock publish for 2026-04-09 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert for changes. Thanks!
